study.title: Why consumers join refill-container schemes (illustrative example)
study.research_question: How do consumers make sense of participating in effortful sustainable-packaging behaviours?
study.target_population: Consumers who have used a refill or reuse scheme at least once

sample_rules.frame: Purposive sample varying in age, frequency of use and household type
inclusion: has used a refill scheme at least once
sample_rules.stopping_rule: Sampling continues while new interviews add to the analysis; sufficiency is judged with information power and logged after each interview. No fixed number is promised.

analysis_plan.hypothesis: Research question guides interpretive coding; no hypotheses to test
analysis_plan.notes: Interview guide may be revised after early interviews; every revision is logged.

holdout_or_blinding.details: Initial interview guide and every later revision are kept with dates; changes are reported.

items_needing_human_verification: Where audio is stored and who can access it
Transcription service terms if one is used
Translation/transcription plan for interviews in Cantonese or Mandarin
governance.storage_and_retention: Audio deleted after transcript verification; pseudonymised transcripts retained.
